title: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past - Anti-Fairy
description:
The Anti-Fairy from The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past.

- Contains the original graphics and a version compatible with palette 09.
- Also contains a compatible sprite, modified from the Reflecting Fireball disassembly. It has been edited to not mirror its graphics when bouncing.

Uses palettes 09 (default) or 0E.
